preconditions.description: The length of permutation a must be between 1 and 200000.
The length of permutation b must be between 1 and 200000.
The lengths of the input permutations a and b must match the specified sizes n and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n for x in a) and all(1 <= x <= m for x in b)
preconditions.description: All elements in permutations a and b must be within the valid range of 1 to n and 1 to m, respectively.
Permutations a and b must contain distinct integers.

postconditions.description: The output must be the count of distinct integers d such that the sequence c is a subsequence of b.
